title: Flyto2 Core unauthenticated command execution via HTTP MCP execute_module (CVE-2026-55786)
summary: flyto-core versions 2.26.2 before 2.26.4 expose an execute_module operation on the HTTP MCP surface without authentication: a caller who can reach the HTTP listener can invoke arbitrary Flyto modules, including ones that run shell commands, without any credential. Fixed in 2.26.4.
